name: @natlang/memetic-improver
description: The memetic improvement supervisor: the policy model studies one program's support invocations and improves the program by typed, measured changes (guidance, skills, instruction and signature patches, adapter fits) through the workspace service, then commits a change set. Episodes of it are trained by whole-graph RL on held query-world gains (training/neuralese rl/memetic_stage.py).
